title: Ad campaigns and creatives REST controller
name: Campaign management API

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the nested creative routes resolve resources under a campaign? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client POSTs a new creative to /api/v2/campaigns/777/creatives and no campaign 777 exists. What happens?
choices: 404 Not Found is returned and no creative row is written
201 Created is returned, and the creative is saved as an orphan with campaignId 777
400 Bad Request, because the body is validated against existing campaigns
404 Not Found is returned, but the creative is saved before the check fails

questions.prompt: A client calls DELETE /api/v2/campaigns/5 twice in a row for a campaign that is ACTIVE at first. What do the two calls return, and what is the state of the campaign afterwards?
choices: 204 then 404, since the campaign row is physically removed by the first call
204 both times; the campaign remains with status ARCHIVED and still resolves for lookups by id
204 then 409, because archiving twice is a conflict
204 both times, and the campaign is now hidden, so GET /api/v2/campaigns/5/creatives returns 404

questions.prompt: A client requests GET /api/v2/campaigns?size=1000&page=2. What does the endpoint do?
choices: Responds 200 with up to 100 items for page index 2, and the body reports size 100
Responds 200 with up to 1000 items, since MAX_PAGE_SIZE is only used for the default
Responds 200 with page 1, because pages are 1-based and are normalized
